personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT structure with 4 Tactile floating interactions
personality_one_liner: A premium, farm-to-table organic market that breathes with elegant typography and delightful bouncy floating interactions.

spacing.rule: Generous organic rhythm. Floating elements sit clearly above the background. Use large bottom padding to clear floating action buttons.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling lists

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Feed of fresh produce categories and featured farm goods.

states.loading: Pull-to-refresh custom veggie loader or centered spinner.
states.empty: Illustration of a basket + 'No fresh items found right now.'

screens.layout: Large hero carousel at the top showing fresh farms (with gradient scrim). Horizontal scroll for categories (Whole Veg, Pre-cut Veg). Vertical masonry or 2-col grid for featured products. A floating, bouncy Cart FAB placed at bottom right.

screens.name: ProductListing
screens.purpose: Grid of vegetables and fruits with filter chips for cut types.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty cutting board + 'Try another cut type.'

screens.layout: Sticky, glassmorphic header containing filter chips (Sliced, Diced, Shredded, Whole). 2-column grid of product cards. Cards have floating soft shadows. Fly-to-cart animation on 'Add' press.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of the selected produce, cut-type selector, and add-to-cart action.
screens.layout: Hero image at the top with pinch/hover to preview. Large elegant display title. Segmented control for cut-type. Quantity picker (250g, 500g, 1kg). Sticky floating glass CTA at the bottom to Add to Cart.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Manage selected items, swipe to delete, and check pincode serviceability.

states.empty: Empty basket illustration + 'Your basket is empty. Add some fresh veggies!'

screens.layout: List of items with swipe-to-delete gesture. Animated total price counter at the bottom. Pin code input field to check serviceability before proceeding to checkout.

whole_vegetables.alt: Fresh whole organic vegetables on table

cut_vegetables.alt: Sliced colorful bell peppers on a cutting board

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize smooth Reanimated micro-interactions: The cart button should have a bouncy spring scale on addition. Use a fly-to-cart animation when items are added from the grid.
Implement the swipe-to-delete in the cart natively using react-native-gesture-handler.
Ensure 'glass' blur surfaces have a tinted base under them (opacity >=70% of surface color) to guarantee text readability.
Do NOT use typical purple/indigo/blue colors. Strictly stick to the earthy, organic palette defined (green, terracotta, warm whites).
Hero images and image cards MUST have a gradient scrim (transparent to dark) on the bottom 40% if text overlays them.
Typography: Use Fraunces for large elegant headers (size xl to 3xl) and DM Sans for highly readable body and labels. Limit max font weight to 500.
Implement safe areas properly, especially preventing the sticky/floating bottom cart CTA from overlapping the home indicator.
